name: Orange Pulp & Fruit Pulping Unit
description: Establish a fruit pulping and concentration unit to process Nagpur's famous mandarin oranges into high-shelf-life pulp and squashes.
checklist: Obtain FSSAI license for food processing
Lease a 1,000 sq.ft. space with clean water access
Purchase fruit washer, pulping machine, and sealing units
Source fresh oranges directly from growers in Narkhed/Katol tehsils
Apply for PMFME 35% capital subsidy scheme

name: Fly Ash Brick Manufacturing
description: Utilize fly ash residues from power stations in Nagpur (Koradi/Khaperkheda) to manufacture high-durability green construction bricks.
checklist: Register enterprise as MSME and apply for Udyam
Acquire 1.5 Acre industrial land lease near thermal power plant corridors
Setup automated fly ash brick press and curing tanks
Secure supply contract for fly ash with power generation utility (MAHAGENCO)
Apply for Maharashtra MSME PSI Capital Subsidy

name: Surgical Cotton Roll Processing
description: Process local short-staple cotton crops grown in Hingna, Saoner, and Kalmeshwar tehsils into sterile surgical cotton rolls for hospitals.
checklist: Secure Drug license for surgical dressings production
Lease 1,200 sq.ft. dry manufacturing workspace
Install carding machines, cotton kier, and sterilizers
Tie up with clinics and hospital distributors in Nagpur town
Apply for Mudra Loan (Tarun category) for working capital support

name: Cold-Pressed Soybean Oil Mill
description: Establish a chemical-free cold-pressed oil extraction unit to process Nagpur soybean crops into premium culinary oil and high-protein oil cakes.
checklist: Acquire FSSAI and local trade licenses
Acquire a commercial shop space of 500 sq.ft.
Install wooden-cold-press (Lakdi Ghana) oil extractor
Procure raw soybean seeds directly from local farmer groups
Market oil cake to local dairy farms as high-grade cattle feed

name: Chilli & Spices Grinding Mill
description: Leverage Nagpur's proximity to Umred and Bhiwapur's famous hot red chilli markets to grind and package premium local spices.
checklist: Register micro-enterprise on Udyam portal
Purchase spice pulverizer, grinding machine, and heat sealer
Source Bhiwapur red chillies directly from local APMC mandis
Pack in 100g, 250g, and 500g bags with custom labeling
Apply for Mudra Shishu/Kishor loan for financing

name: Modern Dairy & Milk Chilling Unit
description: Establish a dairy farm with 10-15 high-yield crossbred cows or buffaloes, integrated with a chilling tank to supply fresh milk.
checklist: Acquire veterinary certificates and animal purchase permits
Lease 1 Acre land with cattle shed, water borewell, and fodder field
Install bulk milk chilling tank (500L capacity) and milking machines
Tie up with dairy co-operatives (e.g. Mahanand / Amul) for bulk sales
Apply for NABARD Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme (DEDS)

name: Rural CSC & Digital Services Center
description: Set up a Common Service Center (CSC) to offer digital documentation (MahaOnline, PAN, Aadhaar link, prints) and financial kiosk services in rural tehsils.
checklist: Apply for CSC VLE registration online
Lease a small road-facing shop (150 sq.ft.) near tehsil office/bus stop
Procure a PC, biometric scanner, laser printer, and UPS battery backup
Install digital banners detailing services and government rates
Link bank account for financial remittance transactions

name: Soil & Water Testing Consultancy
description: Establish a soil testing laboratory providing crop-specific nutrient consultancy to rural orange and cotton farmers in Nagpur.
checklist: Secure accreditation from Directorate of Agriculture
Lease 300 sq.ft. space with proper chemical drainage ventilation
Purchase spectrophotometers, soil pH meters, and nitrogen analyzers
Market testing services at rural weekly markets (Athavadi Bazar)
Offer package deals (Soil Test + Fertilizer prescription chart)

name: Tractor & Agriculture Equipment Workshop
description: Establish a commercial tractor repairing and farming machinery service garage in highly cultivated crop tracts like Ramtek or Kuhi.
checklist: Acquire mechanical certification or hire trained mechanics
Lease a highway-facing open garage space (800 sq.ft.)
Equip workshop with pneumatic tools, diagnostic gauges, and jacks
Partner with tractor spare parts distributors in Nagpur city
Advertise mobile field-breakdown service to nearby villages

name: Agro-Tourism & Orange Orchard Resort
description: Convert local orange farm assets into a weekend agro-tourism getaway for Nagpur city dwellers, offering farm-to-table stays.
checklist: Apply for Agro-Tourism registration with MTDC
Develop 2-3 eco-cottages on existing agricultural orange farm
Create farm activities: fruit picking, bullock cart rides, organic dining
Market resort package on social media channels to Nagpur urbanites
Leverage Maharashtra Tourism Capital Loan Subsidies

name: Micro Bakery & Biscuit Packing
description: Establish a bakery producing fresh bread, biscuits, and local cookies, targeting small retail shops in rural bus stops and town hubs.
checklist: Apply for FSSAI registration and fire safety NOC
Lease a 600 sq.ft. space with adequate electricity load
Purchase deck oven, flour mixer, racks, and packaging sealer
Set up wholesale distribution agreements with tea stalls and groceries
Leverage Mudra Kishor loan to finance machinery costs

name: Fertilizer & Seed Retail Outlet
description: Establish a wholesale-cum-retail seed and fertilizer store to cater to local farmers during Rabi and Kharif crop planting cycles.
checklist: Apply for Seed, Fertilizer, and Pesticide license from Krishi Department
Rent a prominent shop (300 sq.ft.) near local APMC grain market
Tie up with national fertilizer distributors (IFFCO / Mahadhan)
Set up chemical-safe dry racking storage cabinets
Offer farm advisory guidance to build community retail loyalty

name: Solar Pump & Micro-Irrigation Dealership
description: Establish a dealership offering solar irrigation pump setups and drip irrigation systems, aligning with state agrarian subsidies.
checklist: Acquire dealer authorization from solar equipment manufacturers
Lease a highway-accessible shop and display yard (600 sq.ft.)
Stock solar pumps, controllers, and micro-drip irrigation pipes
Register outlet under Mahadbt portal for farmer subsidy processing
Hire basic plumbing/electrician team for local site installation

name: Super Rural Grocery & General Store
description: Open a well-organized general store offering grains, grocery items, cosmetics, and school stationery in rural market squares.
checklist: Register for Shop Act License and local panchayat NOC
Rent a prominent village corner shop (200 sq.ft.)
Set up modular shelving displays and basic billing counter
Source inventories in bulk from wholesale distributors in Nagpur city
Incorporate digital UPI payment codes to encourage cashless sales

name: Organic Poultry & Egg Farm
description: Establish a free-range organic poultry farm to sell organic eggs and broiler chicken to local restaurants and city markets.
checklist: Obtain NOC from local Gram Panchayat and health authority
Construct a protected poultry shed (800 sq.ft.) on agricultural land
Procure day-old high-yield chicks from regional hatcheries
Setup automated drinkers, feeders, and egg-laying nests
Apply for NABARD Poultry Venture Capital Fund (PVCF) subsidy
